title: pyrrosia tricuspis
intro: Pyrrosia tricuspis, commonly known as the Three-pronged Shield Fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pyrrosia tricuspis include its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, as well as its capacity to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
